set.body:
Migrated from canardlapin/scalafim Mote bd-01KY514GPNG0P1W5AJ1TW96CEP on 2026-08-01 after HalfFlow ownership moved to canardlapin/reframe4s.
Source status: open. Source created_at: 2026-07-22T13:44:40.405316Z.

Purpose: run a correctness-first HalfFlow-CC redesign as a falsifiable successor candidate to the current HalfFlow-LM engine. Preserve the current exact-affine factored implementation and its frozen sub18 receipt as a control; do not delete or silently retune it.

Target algebra: exact affine plus one forward residual map per midpoint arm; true neighborhood squared CC; pointwise rank-one damped step; whole-domain Gaussian or normalized-convolution geometry; paired small-flow integration; sampled Jacobians as the anatomical hard gate. LM damping responds only to objective/model behavior, step scale only to topology, and squaring depth only to integration accuracy. Sampled inverse error drives cache repair, deeper integration, or typed export failure, not automatic anatomical rejection.

Correctness rules: native fixed and moving pyramids remain independent; support and reliability weights are frozen during a trial derivative/acceptance calculation; the held-out moving evaluation mask and labels never enter optimization; box-filter boundary semantics must satisfy the stated adjoint contract; all shared numerical kernels and oracles run on JVM and Scala.js. ANTs accuracy comparisons use the identical supplied affine and native inputs. Docker amd64-emulated timing is reported as its own comparator class, never as a native-hardware speed claim.

Acceptance is evidence-bearing, not outcome-presuming. The epic may close with HalfFlow-CC selected, rejected, or narrowed, but only after: reference-vs-fast CC parity; directional-derivative convergence through the real pipeline; mixed-grid and translation contracts; synthetic capture characterization; zero nonpositive sampled Jacobians in admitted runs; export inverses meeting a declared tolerance or returning a typed failure; a controlled multi-pair ablation matrix; and runtime, allocation, peak-memory, support-coverage, rejection-reason, topology, and anatomical receipts.

Scope discipline: general pull, pyramid, box, Gaussian, gradient, composition, and Jacobian operators belong in image. Registration owns CC, midpoint state, controllers, topology policy, and export inversion. Gale changes require a profiled general deficiency and a reusable non-registration-specific contract. FFT, learned features, GPU specialization, lower precision, signed-distance cues, and coarse proposals remain gated until the capture-range evidence demands them.
set.title: EPIC: HalfFlow-CC correctness-first redesign and falsification
